pages.text: Tourists spend travel money on goods; elements flow into the warehouse based on each good's elemental value and profit rate.

$(li)A shop's $(bold)goods list$() is set by its building config; each good carries its own $(bold)Comfort / Magic / Wonder$() values.$(li)Tourists stand on the shop's $(bold)interact spot$() to browse, staying for the building's configured $(bold)interaction duration$().$(li)Tourists spend $(bold)travel money$(); you collect elements based on each good's elemental value and $(bold)profit rate$(). Higher profit rate means more earnings per good.$(li)A good's three values fill the tourist's matching $(bold)need bar$(): high-Comfort goods feed comfort-loving tourists; high-Magic goods feed magic-loving tourists.
pages.title: How It Runs

pages.text: $(bold)Aim your crosshair at the shop and right-click$() to open the panel and set each good's $(bold)max stock$() (0~64). The system auto-restocks from the warehouse; max stock decides how long a good lasts.$(br2)$(italic)$(#6b5a45)A shop needs three things to function: an $(bold)interact spot$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45), goods with $(bold)matching values$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45), and $(bold)road access$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45).$()
pages.title: Operation

pages.text: $(bold)Shop  Goods$()$(li)Bread Shop — 6 kinds of food$(li)Flower Shop — 6 kinds of flowers$(li)Book Shop — 6 kinds of books$(br2)The mod also ships with a Magic Shop. Different shops lean toward different need values; placing them on different streets attracts tourists of different profiles. To configure a new shop: use the shop mode of the $(l:wandscape:creative_scanner_guide)Creative Building Scanner$(/l) to set goods and profit rate — it takes effect on export.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:tourist_guide)Tourist System Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
